## BatteryPulse

Shows an on-screen banner for battery events - percentage step milestones, low-battery thresholds, full charge, and plug in/out. Everything is configurable from Settings, and changes apply live without a respring.

- Percentage step notifications (any percent width you choose) while charging or discharging
- Low-battery notifications at 20%, 10%, and 5%, each toggled independently
- Full charge (100%) notification
- Plug in / unplug notification
- No polling - driven entirely by IOKit power-source change events, so it costs nothing when the battery state isn't changing
- Self-contained on-screen banner, drawn directly by the tweak - no Notification Center / BulletinBoard dependency
- A "Send Test Notification" button in Settings to confirm banners are working

## BatteryPulse

バッテリーの状態変化を画面上のバナーでお知らせします。残量の刻み通知、低残量しきい値、満充電、充電の接続/切断に対応。すべて設定アプリから調整でき、変更はrespring不要でその場に反映されます。

- 指定した幅（数値入力で自由に設定可）で残量が変化するたびに通知（充電中・放電中どちらでも）
- 低残量通知：20%・10%・5%をそれぞれ個別にオン/オフ
- 満充電（100%）通知
- 充電の接続/切断通知
- ポーリングなし：IOKitの電源状態変化イベント駆動のため、状態が変わらない間は一切コストがかかりません
- バナーはTweak自身が描画する自己完結型：通知センター/BulletinBoardに依存しません
- 設定アプリの「テスト通知を送信」ボタンでバナーが機能しているか確認できます

## 1.0.0
- Initial release: step/low-battery/full-charge/plug notifications
- Settings panel with live-apply toggles and a test notification button
- IOKit power-source event driven, no polling
- Self-contained on-screen banner (switched away from libbulletin, which crashed SpringBoard's Notification Center list)
- Step width is a free-form numeric field instead of a coarse slider
- Selectable notification sound, with instant preview in Settings
- Banner now clears the lock screen (was hidden behind it) and queues multiple simultaneous events instead of one overwriting another before being seen
